crossRefs.note: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:
He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East.…
He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

translations.web: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;
translations.bsb: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying, “This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,
translations.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
translations.asv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor saith, And the man whose eye was closed saith;
